title: Cross-venue market comparison, Kalshi vs Polymarket (2026-07-27)
text: Cross-venue liquidity on Kalshi vs Polymarket: Kalshi lists "Pandemic in 2026?" (KXNEWOUTBREAK-P-26) and Polymarket lists "Hantavirus pandemic in 2026?" (2155000); these appear to be the same question. 98% of the $123k combined 24h volume is on Polymarket. It trades at 6.0c on Kalshi and 3.1c on Polymarket.
